title: Recovery 5B - factory restore: SOP0 and SOP1 straps (only after the backup)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Two straps from U15 pin 8, each through 470 Ω, onto X4 (SOP0) and X5 (SOP1). X6 (SOP2) stays free. Never before two equal backups exist.

callouts.label: U15 pin 8, 3.3 V: strap source
callouts.note: VCC = the 3.3 V rail (J-110). The leg across from pin 1 (top-left of U15 in this view). One probe here feeds both straps, each through its own 470 Ω.

callouts.label: X4, SOP0
callouts.note: Top pad of the column right of J14 (J-098). X4 = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 = SOP2 (measured with the beeper, 2026-11-05). Strap through 470 Ω.

callouts.label: X5, SOP1
callouts.note: Middle pad of the column (J-098). X4 = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 = SOP2 (measured with the beeper, 2026-11-05). Strap through 470 Ω.

callouts.label: X6, SOP2: stays free
callouts.note: Bottom pad of the column (J-098). X4 = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 = SOP2 (measured with the beeper, 2026-11-05). Nothing on it in the factory restore.

callouts.label: U15 pin 1 (dimple end)
callouts.note: Orientation mark: the leg at the moulded dimple, beside the two white silkscreen dots. Nothing connects here in this step; pins 1-4 run along this row, 5-8 back along the other, so pin 8 is across from it.
